3..32 simple normalized[0,1] vertices; concave allowed, no holes/crossings/contact/duplicate/adjacent collinear vertices. At most30 triangles for validation; native fill is one <=32-vertex outline with implicit stroke disabled, then original boundary stroke only. Fill/stroke/opacity/center rotation/AOD. Native pixel differences require screenshot verification. External widget/release v2 stays strictly convex.

entries.constraints: First release: Venu4 targets only, printable ASCII <=80 chars, 8 layers. Fixed scalable SMALL face, 400 weight, opacity1, no resource fonts/rotation. Browser font and glyph advances are approximate. Radius fraction/spacing/angle/direction/alignment; conservative one-circle width budget.

One chart object; day1..7 steps/distance/calories or hour1..7 heartRate; bar/trapezoid/segmented/line/area, max4, Venu4 only. Missing breaks curves; hour aggregation mean/max/min/last, no sum; actual elapsed-hour buckets,1024 recent sample processing budget and coverage marker,60s active-only cache; AOD frozen/simplified. ECG not supported.
